summary.note: This capture predates the current floor semantics: it used the signed active-phase integral with <=1% relative error. Current production code uses the absolute real-component integral with <=10% relative error, and requires point-level rotation discrepancy >=1e-2 for the waiver. Replay uses unit outer weight and captured Havana weight is reapplied offline; replay dynamic large-weight/floor decisions do not reproduce the integrator context.
